local-fast.label: Fast, on this computer
local-fast.description: The route of the conversion matrix for each format: Marker fast on the CPU for pages and images, the native tools for the other formats. Nothing leaves this computer.

quality-now.label: Quality now (Modal)
quality-now.description: Pages and images only: Marker balanced with the inference of Surya on a GPU rented by the second on Modal. The page images leave this computer.

batch.label: Batch (RunPod)
batch.description: Pages and images only: Marker balanced with the inference of Surya on a GPU rented by the second on RunPod, one session for the whole queue; the GPU can be armed ahead. The page images leave this computer.

local-gpu.label: Quality on your GPU (this computer)
local-gpu.description: Pages and images only: Marker balanced with the inference of Surya on the NVIDIA GPU of this computer (the gpu profile, make gpu-up). Nothing is rented and nothing leaves this computer. Designed and tested with fake servers only.

remote-gpu.label: Quality on your GPU server
remote-gpu.description: Pages and images only: Marker balanced with the inference of Surya on your own GPU server (make server-up on that machine), over TLS with its key. Nothing is rented; the page images leave this computer. Designed and tested with fake servers only.

datalab.label: Datalab
datalab.description: Pages and images only: the Datalab API in its balanced mode, under the cap of each conversion. The document leaves this computer.
